All upstream and tagged tests pass. Let me update HANDOFF.md to record the milestone-3 state for future arms.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# cachetools.tagged handoff (milestone 3 complete)

## Status
R01-R08 implemented in src/cachetools/tagged.py. All tests pass:
  PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q  -> 317 passed
Upstream tests/ files untouched; tests/test_tagged.py is my own (R01-R06).
/tmp/test_ttl_extra.py holds my extra R07/R08 checks (20 tests, all pass).

## Design (tagged.py)
- TaggedCache(maxsize, timer=None); timer defaults to time.monotonic. Only
  consulted when purging or when a ttl is given (put with ttl computes
  absolute expiry = timer()+ttl).
- _TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache) records evicted keys in _evicted (popitem and
  _resize). Tag memberships pruned via __forget on eviction/removal.
- State: __cache, __expiry {key: absolute expiry or None}, __tags {tag: set(keys)},
  __key_tags {key: set(tags)}.
- put(key, value, tags=(), ttl=None): validates tags (finite iterable of
  str; bare str/bytes and non-str entries -> ValueError) and ttl (None or
  finite nonnegative int/float, bool excluded; math.isfinite check) BEFORE
  any mutation; then purges expired; replaces value/tags/expiry and refreshes
  LRU recency on overwrite; evicts LRU when full.
- get: purges expired first, then KeyError for missing/expired; successful
  get refreshes recency; returns deep copy (detached).
- invalidate / invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all'): validate mode/tags
  before mutation; empty tag set removes 0; purge expired first so counts
  only live entries; no recency refresh.
- resize(maxsize): validate positive non-bool int first (failed resize keeps
  all state); purge expired; shrink evicts LRU; grow never evicts; survivors
  keep values/tags/LRU order AND absolute expiry (no recomputation).
- __purge_expired: drops entries with expiry <= now (exact boundary expired)
  without touching survivor recency; skips None expiries; a raising timer is
  swallowed (no expiry).
- pop/clear/__len__/__contains__ present; clear resets expiry map too.

## Verified edge behaviors
- ttl=0 immediately expired; expiry boundary now >= expiry -> expired.
- invalid ttl/tags/maxsize leave value, tags, recency, expiry unchanged.
- overwrite replaces prior expiry (including ttl->None makes immortal).
- purge before put/len/resize/invalidate keeps survivor recency intact.
- resize preserves absolute expiry (checked at original boundary after resize).
- key reuse after expiry/eviction leaves no stale tag memberships.
- generator tags consumed exactly once.

## Superseded notes
Old design note 'empty all-tags matches every key and resizing may flush the
cache' is WRONG per R04/R05 (empty tags remove 0; resize never flushes).
EOF
echo done"}
